Console.//: TR-NFR-15: logs are centralised, so they are emitted as structured JSON rather than prose.

//: TR-ARC-06: endpoints, credentials, templates and category lists are externalised and
changeable without a code deployment. TR-SEC-28: no credential appears here in plain
text — connection strings and integration secrets come from the secret store, supplied
per environment as environment variables (prefix BITSTREAM_) or IIS configuration.
TR-ARC-07: Development, UAT and Production have isolated data and credentials; only the
non-secret defaults live in this file.
Names only. Values are supplied as environment variables on the application pool,
e.g. BITSTREAM_Secrets__CrmClientSecret. A secret found in this file is refused at
runtime outside Development (TR-SEC-28).
TotpEncryptionKey: base64 AES-256 key encrypting TOTP secrets at rest (TR-SEC-04).
Generate once per environment, e.g. openssl rand -base64 32 — there is no rotation
path, so treat a change as a data migration, not a config change.

PasswordPolicy.//: TR-SEC-02, TR-SEC-03. The validator refuses a configuration weaker than these floors.

TwoFactor.//: TR-SEC-04, TR-SEC-05. Production channel is TRD 11.4 open item 13; Totp needs no delivery path, so it is the default that works before that item is answered.

Identifiers.//: TR-DAT-02a / TR-DAT-02e — prefixes per environment. Values are TRD 11.4 open item 2.

//: TR-ACT-01, TR-ACT-04, TR-PAS-02, TR-PAS-16: every list here must be extensible without
a release. Packages carry a Tier so that upgrade and downgrade eligibility (TR-PAS-35)
is data rather than a hard-coded table.
IspNotifiableStatuses is empty because the CRM status list is TRD 11.4 open item 4;
until it is supplied no status is notifiable, which is the safe default — TR-PAS-13
forbids notifying internal forwards, and guessing would do exactly that.
BaseAddress is blank until TRD 11.4 open item 1 is answered. For local development
against tools/CrmSimulator, run it (dotnet run --project tools/CrmSimulator) and point
this at its URL, e.g. via BITSTREAM_Integration__Crm__BaseAddress.

OutboxDispatcher.//: TR-ARC-03, TR-INT-04, TR-INT-05 — the background dispatcher, not one setting per adapter.

Sap.//: Disabled until TRD 11.4 open item 5 is answered.

Smtp.//: TR-NTF-02 — distribution group membership is TRD 11.4 open item 6.

TicketClosure.//: TRD 6.5 — pending approval as TRD 11.4 open item 9. Configurable per TR-PAS-21a/b.

//: TR-PAS-21a — the working-day calculation uses a maintainable calendar including public
holidays. Holidays are listed per year and must be topped up before each January;
an empty list silently makes every holiday a working day.
